protocol.user_population: reranker experiment confirmation users (already opened once)
protocol.relevance: held-out test positives; validation positives are hidden too and are never excluded

policies.production: one entry per franchise, and nothing from a franchise the user already Liked
policies.dedupe: one entry per franchise; a Liked franchise may contribute one further entry
policies.dedupe_mainline: as dedupe, but a Liked franchise may contribute only a TV series or a film
policies.dedupe_liked1: as dedupe, with at most one entry from Liked franchises in each batch of 18
policies.dedupe_liked3: as dedupe, with at most three entries from Liked franchises in each batch of 18
policies.batch_dedupe: one entry per franchise within each batch of 18; other entries wait for a later batch
policies.cap2: at most two entries per franchise, Liked franchises included

protocol.isolation: assert_isolated() ran for every user and every exclusion arm
